title: Reverse Formation
briefing: A patrol route got recorded back-to-front by a faulty sensor. The formation needs to fly it in reverse order to get home.
objective: Complete the function to return a new table with the elements of the input table in reverse order.
hints: Walk the input table backwards: `for i = #t, 1, -1 do ... end`.
`table.insert(result, value)` appends to the end of a table.

title: Encryption Seed

Check divisibility by every integer from 2 up to the square root of n: `math.floor(math.sqrt(n))`. If any of them divide evenly, it's not prime.

title: Convoy Merge
briefing: Two patrol convoys, each already sorted by arrival time, are converging on the same dock. The final approach schedule has to merge them into one sorted line — the last routine standing between you and a fully operational fleet.
objective: Complete the function to merge two sorted tables into a single sorted table.
hints: Use two pointers, i and j, one for each table, both starting at 1.
At each step, take whichever of a[i] or b[j] is smaller and advance that pointer — once one table runs out, append whatever's left of the other.
